name: inbuxa Admin
description: Administration for the inbuxa mail server
_comment: JSON has no comments, so: every URL below is relative on purpose. The server mounts this one bundle at /admin and at /account, and manifest members resolve against the manifest's own address, so each mount installs as its own app with nothing substituted at build time. It is .json rather than .webmanifest because the server's bundle loader types files by extension and knows json but not webmanifest.
_comment_id: There is deliberately no `id`. The spec resolves it against the origin of start_url rather than this file, so it cannot name a mount; the default id is start_url, which already can. Adding one later gives every installed copy a new identity and orphans it.
